gloss: competitive spirit; rivalry; desire to compete

definitions.gloss: competitive spirit; rivalry; desire to compete
definitions.explanation: The feeling of wanting to compete with or outdo someone else. Can be positive (healthy competition) or negative (petty rivalry), depending on context.

examples.japanese: {対抗心|たいこうしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{燃|も}やす→燃やす：02318_moyasu⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ライバル→ライバル：11197_raibaru⟧⟦に{対|たい}して→に対して：06800_nitaishite⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧{対抗心|たいこうしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っている→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: He has a strong sense of rivalry toward his competitor.

examples.japanese: {対抗心|たいこうしん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{反対|はんたい}して→反対する：05648_hantaisuru⟧しまうこと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Sometimes I end up opposing the other person's opinion out of sheer competitiveness.

notes:
USAGE:
{対抗心|たいこうしん} is a compound of ⟦{対抗|たいこう}→対抗：12398_taikou⟧ (opposition, rivalry) and {心|しん} (heart, spirit). It describes an internal feeling of wanting to rival or outperform someone.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {対抗心|たいこうしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{燃|も}やす→燃やす：02318_moyasu⟧ (to burn with competitive spirit)
- {対抗心|たいこうしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ (to have a competitive spirit)
- {対抗心|たいこうしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{剥|む}き{出|だ}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to openly show one's rivalry)
- {対抗心|たいこうしん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧ (out of rivalry/competitiveness)
